nodes.text: The chart has one safe margin through the harbour mud. It is reconstructed from three workers' notes, so do not mistake a useful line for a stone road.

choices.text: Keep the route open, and mark its uncertainty.

effects.summary: Hinrik shared a harbour chart that kept a Blackheads lighter off the watch schedule.

nodes.text: Good. A marked uncertainty protects the people who taught me the route.
